story.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs

draft:
I just learned that researchers can reverse engineer proprietary LLM APIs to steal reasoning traces. 
This has major implications for IP protection in AI. 
Key takeaways: 
* attacks are highly effective
* mitigation strategies are needed
What does this mean for the future of AI development?
#LLM #AIsecurity #IPprotection
